parameters.help_en: The IP address of the access source
parameters.name: source_ip

parameters.help_en:
The list of alert event IDs.

You can call [DescribeSuspEvents](~~DescribeSuspEvents~~) to obtain alert event IDs from the SecurityEventIds response parameter
parameters.help_zh:
告警事件ID列表。

您可以调用[DescribeSuspEvents](~~DescribeSuspEvents~~)从返回参数SecurityEventIds处获取告警事件ID
parameters.name: suspicious_event_ids

parameters.help_en:
The operation to perform on the alert. Valid values:

deal: handles the alert (quarantine).
ignore: ignores the alert.
mark_mis_info: marks the alert as a false positive (adds it to the whitelist).
rm_mark_mis_info: unmarks the alert as a false positive (removes it from the whitelist).
offline_handled: marks the alert as handled
parameters.help_zh:
设置要对告警进行的操作。取值：

deal：处理告警（隔离）
ignore：忽略
mark_mis_info：标记为误报（加白名单）
rm_mark_mis_info：取消标记为误报（取消加白名单）
offline_handled：标记为已处理
parameters.name: operation

parameters.help_en:
The sub-operation type to perform when quarantining the alert event. Valid values:

killAndQuaraFileByPidAndMd5andPath: terminates the process by PID and quarantines the source file of the process.
quaraFileByMd5andPath: quarantines the source file of the process.
killAndQuaraFileByMd5andPath: terminates the process and quarantines the source file of the process
parameters.help_zh:
设置对告警事件进行隔离时进行的子操作类型。取值：

killAndQuaraFileByPidAndMd5andPath：根据PID结束该进程的运行，并隔离该进程的源文件。
quaraFileByMd5andPath：隔离该进程的源文件。
killAndQuaraFileByMd5andPath：结束该进程的运行，并隔离该进程的源文件
parameters.name: sub_operation

parameters.help_en:
The request source identifier.

Set this parameter to sas, which indicates a request from the Security Center client
parameters.help_zh:
请求来源标识。

固定取值为sas，表示来自云安全中心客户端的请求
parameters.name: from

parameters.help_en:
The type of the exception event to handle. Valid values:

alarm: alert.
Empty: exception
parameters.help_zh:
处理的异常事件的类型。取值：

alarm：告警
不填：异常
parameters.name: warn_type

AccessCode.description_en:
Indicates whether you have the access permission. Valid values:

pass: You have the permission.
no_permission: You do not have the permission
AccessCode.description_zh:
是否有权限访问。取值：

pass：有权限。
no_permission：没有权限

RequestId.description_en: The request ID, which is a unique identifier generated by Alibaba Cloud for the request. You can use this ID to troubleshoot issues
RequestId.description_zh: 本次调用请求的ID，是由阿里云为该请求生成的唯一标识符，可用于排查和定位问题

Success.description_en:
Indicates whether the alert events are handled. Valid values:

true: Handled.
false: Not handled
Success.description_zh:
异常事件处理的结果状态。取值：

true：处理成功。
false：处理失败
